FBLA.description: Floor Load (FBLA). FLOOR_DIST_TYPE selects the distribution model and drives which fields apply: sub-beam and unit-weight fields (LOAD_ANGLE, SUB_BEAM_NUM, SUB_BEAM_ANGLE, UNIT_SELF_WEIGHT, OPT_EXCLUDE_INNER_ELEM_AREA, OPT_ALLOW_POLYGON_TYPE_UNIT_AREA) are read only for One Way (1) and Two Way (2); NODES gives the polygon vertices defining the loading area.

FLOOR_LOAD_TYPE_NAME.description: Name of an existing Floor Load Type (FBLD). Must reference a defined floor load type; a non-empty name that does not resolve is rejected.

FLOOR_DIST_TYPE.description: Distribution Type. 1 = One Way, 2 = Two Way, 3 = Polygon-Centroid, 4 = Polygon-Length. Values 1 and 2 additionally use the sub-beam / unit-weight fields.

LOAD_ANGLE.description: [FLOOR_DIST_TYPE=1|2] Load Angle A1 (degrees). Applied only for One Way / Two Way distribution.

SUB_BEAM_NUM.description: [FLOOR_DIST_TYPE=1|2] Number of sub beams. Applied only for One Way / Two Way distribution.

SUB_BEAM_ANGLE.description: [FLOOR_DIST_TYPE=1|2] Sub-Beam Angle A2 (degrees). Applied only for One Way / Two Way distribution.

UNIT_SELF_WEIGHT.description: [FLOOR_DIST_TYPE=1|2] Unit self weight of the sub beams. Applied only for One Way / Two Way distribution.

DIR.description: Load Direction. Case-insensitive. LX/LY/LZ = local axes, GX/GY/GZ = global axes.

OPT_PROJECTION.description: Whether the load is applied on the projected area (true) rather than the actual area.

DESC.description: Free-text description of the floor load.

OPT_EXCLUDE_INNER_ELEM_AREA.description: [FLOOR_DIST_TYPE=1|2] Exclude inner elements of the loading area. Applied only for One Way / Two Way distribution.

OPT_ALLOW_POLYGON_TYPE_UNIT_AREA.description: [FLOOR_DIST_TYPE=1|2] Allow polygon-type unit area. Applied only for One Way / Two Way distribution.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of an existing Load Group (LDGR). A non-empty name that does not resolve to a defined load group is rejected; empty string means no group.

NODES.description: Node numbers defining the vertices of the loading area polygon, in order. Only the first 32 (D_FBLA_MAXNOD) are used; at least 3 vertices are expected.
